<p>&nbsp;</p>
These exercises are about getting an AI to critique work, and checking the critique.

**Do not paste protected or unpublished data into any AI tool.**

**Exercise 1** - **Review a piece of work**

- ??Take a short piece of your own (non-sensitive) work and ask the assistant, in a fresh session, to find faults. Verify each issue it raises. How many were real???
